facts.claim: Rotterdam (Holland America Line): Entered service 2021; 99,840 GT; 2660 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 300 m length; Pinnacle class.
Rotterdam is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4 km2).
